minutes.headline: Planning Board granted a sign special permit at One Main Street and approved the Asian Imperial site plan conditions.
minutes.summary: The board heard the Lunenburg Village Realty sign request, granted waivers and the special permit with a 30-day construction limit. It endorsed the Goodrich Street common driveway location and approved the 509 Electric Avenue Asian Imperial plan with revised conditions. It then reviewed overlay districts in the use-table rewrite and set upcoming agendas.
